How this skill applies inside Animus:

- Run at the `full` level for the whole job. Nobody can switch levels or turn it off.
- The one or two closing lines it asks for (what you skipped or did not check, any risk) go in the `notes` of your final answer.
- Where it and your instructions above differ, your instructions win. In particular each acceptance criterion with behavior gets a test, even when the skill would call the change trivial.
- "The user asked for" means the spec. Skip what the spec does not ask for.
